purpose: Document the sources used by AirTrust prescriptive FRMS compliance without inferring an operator-selected RBAC 117 appendix or an ANAC-accepted GRF/SGRF.

sources.authority: Sindicato Nacional dos Aeronautas / Costa do Sol
sources.title: Acordo Coletivo de Trabalho Costa do Sol 2025/2027
verified_points: Clause 8: 44h weekly and 176h monthly work composition
Clause 9: mission regime 21 consecutive days / 17 effective work days; 176h monthly preserved

sources.title: Lei 13.475/2017
verified_points: Aeronaut work/flight-time statutory limits and collective-agreement framework

sources.title: IS 117-001 Revisão C
verified_points: Appendix selection is operator-specific; helicopter operations requiring two pilots may have Appendix C applicability subject to the regulatory conditions

operator_specific_evidence.rule: Do not infer Appendix B or C from HELICOPTER_OFFSHORE, RBAC 135, aircraft type, profile name, or source parameters. B/C-specific rules remain disabled until controlled operator-specific evidence is registered.

prescriptive_sources_still_applicable_wi: RBAC 117 provisions whose applicability does not depend on an undocumented B/C selection
copyright_note: Only source identifiers, URLs, hashes and short factual traceability statements are versioned here; third-party source documents are not stored in the repository.
